mapper.sql: id, user_id, family_id, refresh_token_hash, created_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, replaced_by_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sessions WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{hash} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sessions WHERE family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sessions (user_id, family_id, refresh_token_hash, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{familyId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sessions SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = 'ROTATED', replaced_by_id = #{nextId} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sessions SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason} WHERE family_id = #{familyId}
